title: Acquisition-local held-condition calcium response prediction
disposition_reason: The historical full12 route predicts acquisition-local condition means over native frames, which is narrower than visual/opto-combination and animal-transfer generalization. Its source and grader are absent here; unknown mouse mapping and physical timing preclude the broader claim.

scientific_target.question: Within each of six source acquisitions, can the permitted eleven conditions predict the withheld ABC/CBA condition response profile better than additive/order-agnostic models?
scientific_target.known_answer: Measured held-condition calcium response values on each acquisition’s native frame grid, aggregated only by the original declared target rule. The exact mean/trajectory reduction must be recovered from its absent scorer; test-condition means cannot be supplied as predictors.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Source sequenceFiltering.zip record18726362 contains figure2/3 condition arrays and trial/summary forms. The historical finite task declares acquisition-local condition means, not all single-trial visual/opto response combinations.
scientific_target.case_unit: One held condition for one acquisition, with ROI rows and native frames nested inside;12 contexts represent six acquisitions×two order conditions.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Acquisition for descriptive finite results; independent animal/session mapping is unresolved, so six acquisitions cannot be asserted to be six mice.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Retrospective within-acquisition condition generalization only. Full native-frame means may include baseline/artifact structure; physical stimulus onset and animal transfer are outside the delivered claim.
exclusions: No cross-animal generalization or independent-animal uncertainty.
No millisecond response-window or original-paper reproduction claim from native frame indices.

inputs: Training measurements from the eleven permitted conditions in the same acquisition, with condition/order/stimulation metadata allowed by the source task.
Acquisition-local ROI axes and native frame grids; permitted stimulus identity/history and optical power/timing descriptors.
forbidden_inputs: Any withheld-condition response, trial average or summary computed from query observations.
Pooling different acquisition ROI indices as if they were the same cells.
Answer-bearing source-condition filenames outside the sanitized public mapping.
observation_contract.case_identity: Historical declaration: six acquisitions,12 contexts,1132 original ROI rows,2264 query-ROI occurrences, native frame lengths240/240/240/240/200/200 and seven source-empty rows per order. Concrete query IDs and complete missing-row map are not distributed.
observation_contract.split: Hold out the complete declared order/condition response within each acquisition; all duplicated panels from the same acquisition stay grouped. Biological train/test split awaits experiment→mouse/session map and cannot be inferred from expt1…6.
observation_contract.coverage: Complete selected acquisition-local condition-means declaration only; broader single-trial visual/opto-combination and animal-transfer objective remains unimplemented. Two order conditions do not create two new cohorts.

primary.name: acquisition_macro_normalized_response_rmse
primary.aggregation: Compute response RMSE on the frozen measured target support within each acquisition, normalize using training-only scale, and average acquisitions equally; retain ROI/frame support and native units.
primary.rationale: Measures held-condition neural prediction. Normalizer, target reduction and empty-row handling must be frozen from recovered source before use; do not reward copied published panel summaries.

secondary: Unnormalized native-unit RMSE and all per-acquisition/order errors.
Additive/order-agnostic versus sequence-aware matched model errors on identical support.
Post-onset versus baseline/artifact sensitivity only after physical timing is verified, not by relabeling arbitrary frame indices.

comparators.name: Training-condition mean
comparators.procedure: Fixed mean predictor establishes condition-independent response baseline; never average withheld condition.

comparators.name: Additive stimulus/history model
comparators.inputs: Allowed stimulus components, order/history and optical-dose metadata plus training responses.
comparators.procedure: Training-only fitted additive model with fixed regularization; same inputs/budget as richer candidate.

comparators.name: Sequence interaction model
comparators.inputs: Same allowed inputs with declared sequence/order terms.
comparators.procedure: Predict withheld order using training data only; evaluate all acquisition/order cells rather than favorable subsets.

nuisance_controls: Keep optical power, timing and stimulated/nonstimulated support matched.
Freeze exact target mean/trajectory reduction and handling of seven empty rows per order.
Prevent leakage through averaged test responses or repeated panels of the same acquisition.
Separate source-summary prediction from trial variability and physical evoked-response claims.
evaluation.uncertainty: Descriptive acquisition-level differences only until mouse/session independence is established.1132 ROI rows and2264 occurrences are not biological replicate counts; unknown reused acquisitions prohibit pooled animal intervals.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require complete12-context identity and defined support before private grading; preserve empty source rows as declared invalid/undefined rather than silently dropping them. Reject shape/unit/frame mismatches and nonfinite outputs. No score from the unscored producer manifest alone.

implementation.scorer_target: No executable scorer is present. Retained metadata declares one_complete12_collection_unscored and a separate original private grader, so exact response reduction/normalization are unverified despite source scope counts.
implementation.delivered_scope: Manifest-only full12 acquisition-local condition-mean declaration. Original code/data audit supports source availability but does not provide the finite producer/grader in this checkout.
missing: Recover finite response target, normalization/empty-row policy, exact IDs, producer and grader.
Resolve acquisition→mouse/session identity and source physical time axis.
Implement separate broader visual/opto-combination condition only if its actual observations and outcomes are available.
implementation.execution_evidence: Exact full12 adapter is marked not_run; source controls do not establish native execution, measured scores or population uncertainty.

missing: Implement audited task-specific image transport and complete answer collection; no viewer/model result exists here.
